name: Being A Deacon
overview: Scripture presents the role of a deacon as one of faithful service within the church, addressing practical needs such as caring for widows to maintain unity among believers, as seen in Acts 6:1. Deacons are recognized alongside elders as leaders who support the spiritual and organizational health of the church (Philippians 1:1; Titus 1:5). Their conduct should reflect holiness, good works, and submission to authority, embodying Christlike character and readiness to serve (Titus 2:3; Titus 3:1). This role is vital for upholding the truth and purity of the church community.
